corrections.text: The article quotes Mark Reinhold as saying the release-candidate change was made "due to an increase in frequency of Critical Patch Updates (CPUs)." The cited InfoQ report does not present this as a direct quotation from Reinhold; it is InfoQ's own paraphrase of his announcement, and the source text does not include the word "an" before "increase." The underlying fact — that the schedule change was made because of increasingly frequent Critical Patch Updates — is accurate and supported by the source.
